runtime_overlay.application: Install numpy==2.3.5 with --no-deps after uv sync --frozen; preserve the original Isaac Lab lock bytes and use this same overlay for both allocations and both FlashSAC recipes.

gpu_model: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

schedule.balanced: Within each allocation, each recipe occupies each within-seed position once and each directed within-seed predecessor occurs once. Across both allocations each occurs twice. Official/native order for0,2; native/official for1,3.
schedule.limitation: Cross-seed boundary transitions and compiler-cache histories are not balanced. Seeds partition across GPUs, so allocation and seed are confounded; this is not same-seed device replication.

figures.name: quality-transitions
figures.title: FlashSAC quality over the extended, fixed budget
figures.caption: Every faint curve is one seed; solid lines are means and shading is observed min/max, not a confidence interval. In the transition plot, the dotted marker is the old 400-iteration budget. Individual solid/dashed seed curves identify allocation A/B; means/ranges describe all four disjoint seeds, not replicated devices. Wall curves use actual portable checkpoint write-finished times; mean lines use mean times.

figures.name: historical-duration-quality
figures.title: Prior budgets and fresh 400 / 2,000 / 10,000 checkpoints
figures.caption: Dots retain all four seeds; horizontal marks and whiskers show mean and observed min/max. Prior A/B are unchanged historical results. Only the fresh 400 / 2,000 / 10,000 columns follow the same new learning trajectories; old/new GPU load, caches and stochastic trajectories can differ.

figures.name: execution-wall
figures.title: Complete execution cost, independent of balancing success
figures.caption: Each panel retains its two paired seeds; bars are means and whiskers min/max. Checkpoint/replay/logging costs are nested in the loop/process, never added twice. Installation/upload are excluded; caches and clocks are chronological, not controlled cold-start trials.

figures.name: threshold-intervals
figures.title: Time to balancing is interval censored, never interpolated
figures.caption: Intervals end at the first observed passing policy. Right triangles are failures to reach the gate by 10,000, not fast successes. Quality is evaluated offline from saved checkpoints; these clocks are not online success-detection latency.
